description: Single-state parcel-detail page for the capture node + captureOnFailure tests. No transitions: a capture reads the CURRENT document (the whole document, or the #content subtree via a selector), and a run that fails after navigating here exercises captureOnFailure. The detail link carries a credential-SHAPED `token=` query param that a capture must preserve VERBATIM — the customer's own scraped content going to the customer's own storage must never be rewritten by the credential-param scrubber (issue #70). No Chromium, no live traffic.
